shared_elements: possible anthropomorphic form or body parts
justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces include schematic circular/linear motifs and possibly human-related forms, such as a simple circle on A and a circular facial or body feature on B. The major difference is that A is a spread-out panel of many small linear animal and sign figures, while B is dominated by a single frontal anthropomorphic face/body with organized facial features and bands.
